reasons: Verified product facts support this first-email scope: One email introduces ChartMogul as a subscription analytics platform for recurring-revenue reporting and gives one next step: start the 14-day free Pro trial and connect Stripe, Paddle, or another billing system, after which ChartMogul builds the subscription model automatically so MRR and related recurring-revenue metrics come from one model instead of hand-joined exports. A customer testimonial (OneVision) is used as proof that normalizing billing data in ChartMogul produced defensible, dollar-level revenue clarity.

allowed_claims: ChartMogul is trusted by over 3,000 leading software companies, including Softr, Buffer, Pitch, Signeasy, Todoist, and Teamwork.com.
Try Pro free for 14 days, then choose the plan that's right for your business.
You can connect Stripe, Paddle, or your billing system, after which ChartMogul builds your subscription model automatically and you can ask your first questions and get useful answers.
ChartMogul gave OneVision recurring revenue clarity down to the dollar after normalizing their data, per Joseph Kolchinsky, Founder and CEO of OneVision
ChartMogul supports multiple billing systems, automatically connecting subscriptions across systems to maintain accurate timelines and smooth MRR reporting for each customer
ChartMogul supports non-paid (free) subscriptions and free trials with plans, giving a full picture of how free trials and free users behave, when they convert, and how they impact recurring revenue
ChartMogul supports tiered plans, multi-component subscriptions, add-ons, and usage-based overage charges via a flexible, subscription data model battle-tested by thousands of SaaS businesses
ChartMogul tracks revenue across multiple currencies, even when customers switch billing currency mid-lifecycle, and shows how currency movements affect MRR separately from true expansion
Companies can benchmark their revenue metrics apples-to-apples against 2,500+ peer SaaS companies, comparing by similar ARR or ARPA
ChartMogul Pro plan can be tried free for 14 days, then customers choose the plan that's right for their business
